messages:
marta: Morning team, I'm onboarding as a PM-design hybrid today. Two quick access/payments questions: 1) I can't find the UX research consent template or the participant stipend process. 2) I need access to the study recruitment tool (ResearchHub) to kick off a screener. Who handles billing/requisitions for participant payments?

ev an: welcome @marta! For ResearchHub access ping ops and they'll add you. Recruitment billing usually goes through research ops (cc @natalie). We typically use a prepaid card for small stipends or a vendor invoice for panels >$2k.

natalie: hi @marta 44b I run research ops. Consent templates are in Drive > UX > Research Templates (consent_v2.docx). I'll DM you a direct Drive link. For payments: fill out the Research Payment form (Drive > UX) and attach the recruitment plan. Ops issues the prepaid card and handles vendor billing. If you need a one-off $50 gift card per participant we can do that via prepaid.

marta: thanks! Can you add me to the ResearchHub org? I tried the tool link and it said "access denied". Also is there a standard consent script for moderated sessions?

ops-bot: :package: Request received. Ticket #OPS-4077 created for ResearchHub access for marta@redwood.com. Expect approval within 24h.

natalie: Moderated script: use consent_v2 and the moderated_guide template. We always read consent aloud at the start and record the participant's verbal confirmation. If it's external participants, legal sign-off required on the messaging (privacy/data retention). @legal please advise on short-notice sign-off turnaround.

legal: Hi @natalie, we can usually review consent language within 48 hours for standard templates. If you're changing data retention or adding audio/video export, that's where it takes longer. Put the doc in Legal Review workspace on Notion (link: Notion > Legal > Reviews) and tag us there.

marta: Perfect. One more: where do we store recordings & transcripts? I know we have Drive but curious if we tag them anywhere for reuse/search.

ev an: recordings go to Drive > UX Recordings and we add a Notion research note page that links to the recording and has taxonomy tags (persona, feature, hypothesis). We also add the session ID to the Research Index spreadsheet for discoverability.

natalie: If you're interested in shadowing a recruiting call or a moderated session this week I can set that up. Also FYI we have an internal research slack channel #user-research where we post upcoming sessions and recruitment asks. I'll invite you there.

marta: I'd love to shadow, thanks. 2pm tomorrow works. Please invite me to #user-research and drop the Drive link.

ops-bot: :white_check_mark: Access ticket OPS-4077 updated: ResearchHub invite sent to marta@redwood.com.

evan: added @marta to #user-research. Welcome aboard! If you need a quick runthrough of the recruitment flow, ping me and I can demo the ResearchHub dashboard in 15 mins.

marta: Appreciate it all 44f I'll start the payment form and prep a draft screener. See you tomorrow at 2pm for the shadow.
